card.name: Words about location within boundaries
card.fires_on: Small place words like in, on, within, or boundaries after located, lives, or a region/jurisdiction term. It also fires on border and cross-cutting words.

modes.label: Located in a place
modes.description: Preposition after located or lives, introducing a named place or area.
modes.example: He can't confirm whether the individual who has the illness lives<< in>> Vermillion.

modes.label: Borders and jurisdiction
modes.description: Words about borders, boundaries, or crossing between areas or institutions.
modes.example: as their distribution extends beyond the<< boundaries>> of the current Park.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about crossing boundaries and parts of a region, and away from words about alternatives or feedback.
card.plain: It marks words that say where something is located or that talk about borders and crossing them.
